description: HELLS WRATH have appeared on the radar. They are catching up.
We have entered the 50+ Forgotten zone! But our lead at the top is slipping away.
We change course and move to the left to accommodate our and our allies' dig lanes.
"Our ally has secured some good POI causing them to grow like mushrooms." -- CiC
Pesky red dots have appeared, probably from Casino, to spy on us. But we move.
We have well and truly entered the satellite impact zone.
Shiion_NOD and ArabianKnight202 lays waste on Forgotten bases to secure a high value Reactor. We are back!
Wrath has stolen a march on us but not for long. Our power grows.
Our enemies have moved closer. CiC sounds the alarm to build up defense levels.
Two gigantic Tiberium POIs secured back to back. Our bases are growing at an unstoppable rate now.
BIG FUCKING REACTOR!!! We are unstoppable now!
Big reactor lost temporarily but eddi13131 and paladinstr8 team up to kill the ugliest of bases and secure a Reactor-Tiberium double POI.
The enemy has gathered on both sides. War looms.
There is a lull as the enemy retreats temporarily to secure high-value POIs.
!!! WAR !!! The barbarians are at the gate.
"The enemy wishes to cut us in half. Once both sides are in range they will surely attack." -- CiC
The first skirmishes have occurred. Losses on both sides, as barlic1alan, effe3005, eddi13131, redmatch1, and Shiion_NOD lead the defense.
Honors even on the first day. They have prepared well.
HELLS WRATH, formerly our allies, has turned red as well.
The enemy have sent their 2nd alliance to our sector and started attacking our 2nd alliance.
HELLS WRATH has been ambushed in the middle by redmatch1. A large chunk of enemy territory has been bitten off.
After a brief setback, oGunhand caps off a brilliant counter by finishing off GanjaMaster_PL. Absolute cinema.
HELLS WRATH, formerly our enemies, formerly our allies, have now turned purple.
redmatch1, Shiion_NOD, and effe3005 team up to deliver a bloodbath for the enemy on the right flank. Armies have lined up on the left. Tension builds.
effe3005 has been sleeping with his defenses exposed during a war, inviting a daring attack from the enemy.
ArabianKnight202, Shiion_NOD, Butchers_Sohn79, and 54Whiskey lead a total rout of the enemy on the right hand side.
redmatch1 and DarkLordDementia has joined the party on the right. The right flank of the enemy has been all but wiped out.

War breaks out finally on the left flank. paladinstr8 tastes pvp for the first time after waiting here patiently for a week. Many shots back and forth. Could not finish the kill but could not be killed either, although peregrine16 has perished in the melee. Support weapons too strong on both sides. Many lessons.
Shiion_NOD, redmatch1, Butchers_Sohn79, TheDiabolos, DarkLordDementia, and PatrickStar1991 lead an absolute rout of the enemy on the left.
paladinstr8, after being sat here for so long, went for lunch and missed the jump. Omnishambles...
!!! TOTAL VICTORY !!!
A member of the enemy, FrynoX2410, has relocated to our sector and is attacking our 2nd alliance.
FrynoX2410 remains a pesky nuisance.
Eagle Fang alliance, having done fuck all during the war, now demand 3rd place, leading to a cessation of our prevailing non-aggression pact. More trouble ahead.
Butchers_Sohn79 has had his final meltdown and gotten himself kicked from the alliance. Inevitable. :D
We have now occupied the center.
The timer has started! Prep has begun for the attack on the fortress.

Today we received the tragic news that our brother (zib64/igor) has died. He passed away in his sleep on September 2nd. zib64 was part of our core team for over 8 years. He now has followed our brother peadawg to a more peaceful place. May our Russian and American brothers rest in peace.
We have met the enemy again from the other side. Because the earth is round.
Initial skirmishes have broken out. A couple of our players have had arobthh and jumped in without backup or proper pvp setup. CiC is miffed at clown-show.
The enemy has relocated a lot of players to our sector and are attacking our 2nd and 3rd alliances. This includes players from Casino and our own cry baby clown from Austria.
